value.body: History as a major studies the past through sources — ancient, medieval and modern Indian history, world history, and historiography (how history is written). The work is mostly reading primary and secondary sources and writing long-form arguments.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Central and many other universities admit through CUET-UG, where the subject itself can be one of the tests counted; others admit on Class 12 marks or their own test. Some universities fix the major at admission; others, under the NEP four-year programme, let students settle it after the first year.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work routes include teaching, archives, museums and heritage, research, publishing, journalism and tourism.
Museum, archaeology and archival roles usually need specialised postgraduate training, such as museology or archaeology.
History is part of the general-studies syllabus in civil-services exams and is also offered as an optional subject.
Common next steps: an M.A. History, a B.Ed, a 3-year LL.B, or civil-services preparation.
